at home.

Explore Tuscany ↗
01 The setting +
Villa Oliva, Tuscany, Italy. Our sample venue is nestled among olive groves and rolling hills. Final address and travel directions will be shared with guests.
02 What to wear +
Garden formal. Think summer suits, flowing dresses, and soft colors. The ceremony is outdoors, so block heels or flats will feel right at home.
03 Getting there & staying +
Florence is a lovely starting point for your Tuscan weekend. Accommodation recommendations and shuttle details will be shared closer to the celebration.
04 A note on gifts +
Your presence is the gift we treasure most. Traveling to celebrate with us means the world, and no other gift is expected.
